data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word 'hippos', meaning 'horse'. In Greek mythology, Phip was a name given to various gods and heroes associated with horses. Parents who choose Phip usually hope their child will grow to embody lover of horses and live with faith, good character and purpose.

in_hebrew.long_meaning: פיפ הוא השם העברי הקצר של פיליפוס, שפירושו אוהב סוסים. השם פיליפוס מורכב משתי מילים: פילי, שפירושו אוהב, ו-היפוס, שפירושו סוס. השם פיפ הוא שמו הקצר הנפוץ של פיליפוס, המשמש לעתים קרובות ככינוי חיבה.

in_greek.name: Φίπ
in_greek.meaning: Φίπ: σύντομο όνομα του Φίλιππος, φίλος των ιππών
in_greek.long_meaning: Φίπ είναι το σύντομο ελληνικό όνομα του Φίλιππος, που σημαίνει φίλος των ιππών. Το όνομα Φίλιππος προέρχεται από τις λέξεις φίλος και ίππος, που σημαίνει φίλος των σπορίων. Το Φίπ είναι κοινό ψευδώνυμο για τον Φίλιππο, που χρησιμοποιείται συχνά ως υποκοριστικό.

in_latin.name: Phip
in_latin.meaning: Phip: short form of Philippus, lover of horses
in_latin.long_meaning: Phip is the short Latin form of Philippus, which means lover of horses. The name Philippus comes from the Greek words philos, meaning love, and hippos, meaning horse. Phip is often used as a diminutive form of Philippus, commonly used in Christian traditions.

in_english.name: Phip
in_english.meaning: Lover of horses, short form of Philip
in_english.long_meaning: Phip is a shortened form of the name Philip, which originates from the Greek name Philippus, meaning lover of horses. The name Philippus is derived from the Greek words 'philos' (love) and 'hippos' (horse). In Christian tradition, Phip is often used as a nickname for Philip, who was one of Jesus' twelve apostles. The name Phip symbolizes a strong connection to horses and is associated with qualities like courage, loyalty, and strength.
